Title: Cope's Rule
Content: Cope's Rule states that the average size of animals preserved in the fossil record tends to increase as `text(each group)` evolves from a previous group. This rule was `text(first)` proposed in the `text(1800s)` by Edward Drinker Cope, a famous fossil hunter of that time. Recent research, involving well over `text(10,000)` fossil groups spanning the time since the start of the Cambrian Period until today, has shown that Cope's Rule is accurate for most animal groups. Brachiopod data support Cope's Rule.
